# Gateway test fixtures

Authored 20 October 2026. `repository.json` is a synthetic GitHub-shaped response,
not a live capture. Counts and timestamps are test data. Tests derive malformed,
private, hostile-text, oversized and rate-limited responses from it. A deliberately
unknown field proves the gateway returns only its output allowlist.

Fixtures establish local behavior only. A real gateway/HTTPS/GitHub journey and
operator ownership review remain required before connector registry approval.
